nodes.label: Prompt Engineering
nodes.rationale: Prompt Engineering is the craft of designing inputs that steer LLMs toward desired behavior.

nodes.label: Reinforcement Learning
nodes.rationale: Reinforcement Learning (RL) is a branch of Machine Learning where an agent learns a policy by maximizing cumulative reward from interactions with an environment.

nodes.label: Orchestrator
nodes.rationale: The Orchestrator is the execution engine of an AI Agent system.

nodes.label: Planner
nodes.rationale: The Planner is an agent component responsible for decomposing a user request into a sequence of operations.

nodes.label: Neural Networks
nodes.rationale: Neural Networks are parameterized function approximators inspired by biological neurons. They are the architectural backbone of deep learning, a branch of Machine Learning.

nodes.label: Multi-Agent Systems
nodes.rationale: Multi-Agent Systems coordinate several specialized AI Agents — such as a Planner, an Orchestrator, and a Reviewer — to solve problems beyond any single agent. They rely on shared memory, often a Knowledge Graph, and on message-passing protocols.

nodes.label: Typography
nodes.rationale: A peripheral, mostly disconnected note in this knowledge base.

nodes.label: Obsidian
nodes.rationale: Obsidian is a local-first note-taking application that stores notes as plain Markdown files.

nodes.label: Ontology
nodes.rationale: An Ontology is a formal specification of the types, properties, and relations that can exist in a domain.
